review_recommendation: Preserve >=80% union coverage by cylinders/conical angular patches; do not downgrade the independent requirement. The raw wall has multiple radial laws, not one globally fitted primitive.

Revise the single analytic-wall expectation to an explicit mixed/faceted finite wall. Preserve all raw triangle witnesses and the measured 2.7 mm circular boundary rims; do not infer that the opening is absent. A rigid cone/cylinder has no single radial law explaining all four ring layers at submicron fit accuracy.
